status: additional comparison after first-pass final results were seen; not a new blind test
tree_parameters: original ase.LGB_PARAMS, 500 trees, L2 seed42 and L1 seed43; n_jobs=2
state_grid: original ase.run grid: harmonics {2,min(4,(period-1)//2)}, qr {0.02,0.1}, trend_q {0,0.0001}, damp0.98; original state chosen on latest development window, pooled state chosen on mean nonzero-series WAPE across both development windows
original: original ase._fit_weights and ase._combine: 3 horizon stages, latest development window; L2+L1+selected state
improved_static: same fitter, both development windows stacked, one weight vector across horizon; L2+L1+pooled-selected state
fitter: original mean per-series WAPE on positive denominators; gate1.5, simplex step0.05, shrink1/3 to equal; zero-target series excluded from weight fitting but INCLUDED in aggregate final error
comparators: best single selected by pooled development aggregate WAPE
equal arithmetic and equal log of original components
adaptation_limits: dataset adapter required; this ports the existing algorithm, not a bitwise reproduction of M4/Rossmann experiments. timing: base refits and state search separately logged; combination selection/application timing separate from total base model cost
metrics: mean positive-series WAPE with excluded count
